messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have any signs of an allergic reaction to famotidine.
Signs of an allergic reaction to famotidine include hives.
Signs of an allergic reaction to famotidine also include difficult breathing.
Signs of an allergic reaction to famotidine also include swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Stop using Famotidine and call your doctor at once if you have:
confusion, hallucinations, agitation, lack of energy;
a seizure;
fast or pounding heartbeats, sudden dizziness (like you might pass out).
Some side effects may be more likely in older adults and in people who have severe kidney disease.
Common famotidine side effects may include:
headache;
dizziness; or
constipation or diarrhea.
This is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.
You may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.

B. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
